028/**
029 * Routes messages to a publisher by providing a {@link Route} from a logger name and
030 * level.
031 */
032public sealed interface LogRouter extends LogLifecycle {
033
034        /**
035         * Finds a route.
036         * @param loggerName topic.
037         * @param level level.
038         * @return route never <code>null</code>.
039         */
040        public Route route(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level);
041
042        /**
043         * Global router which is always available.
044         * @return global root router.
045         */
046        public static RootRouter global() {
047                return GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE;
048        }
049
050        /**
051         * A route is similar to a SLF4J Logger or System Logger but has a much simpler
052         * contract.
053         *
054         * The proper usage of Route in most cases is to call {@link #isEnabled()} before
055         * calling {@link #log(LogEvent)}.
056         *
057         * That is {@link #log(LogEvent)} does not do any checking if the event is allowed
058         * furthermore by first checking if {@link #isEnabled()} is true one can decide
059         * whether or not to create a {@link LogEvent}.
060         */
061        public sealed interface Route extends LogEventLogger {
062
063                /**
064                 * Determines if {@link #log(LogEvent)} maybe called.
065                 * @return true if log can be called.
066                 */
067                public boolean isEnabled();
068
069                /**
070                 * Route singletons and utilities.
071                 */
072                @CaseChanging
073                public enum Routes implements Route {
074
075                        /**
076                         * A route that is a NOOP and is always disabled.
077                         */
078                        NotFound {
079                                @Override
080                                public void log(LogEvent event) {
081                                }
082
083                                @Override
084                                public boolean isEnabled() {
085                                        return false;
086                                }
087
088                        };
089
090                }
091
092        }
093
094        /**
095         * Router flags for adhoc router customization.
096         */
097        @CaseChanging
098        public enum RouteFlag {
099
100                /**
101                 * The route will not use the global level resolver and will only use the level
102                 * config directly on the router.
103                 */
104                IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER;
105
106                static Set<RouteFlag> parse(Collection<String> value) {
107                        if (value.isEmpty()) {
108                                return EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
109                        }
110                        var s = EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
111                        for (var v : value) {
112                                s.add(parse(v));
113                        }
114                        return s;
115                }
116
117                static RouteFlag parse(String value) {
118                        String v = value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
119                        return RouteFlag.valueOf(v);
120                }
121
122        }
123
124        /**
125         * Root router is a router that has child routers.
126         */
127        sealed interface RootRouter extends LogRouter permits InternalRootRouter {
128
129                /**
130                 * The sink to dispatch events to for a logger name, with <strong>no level based
131                 * gating</strong> - unlike {@link #route(String, java.lang.System.Logger.Level)},
132                 * the returned {@link LogEventLogger} always accepts
133                 * {@link LogEventLogger#log(LogEvent)} regardless of what level is currently
134                 * enabled. Use this when level gating is already handled independently (e.g. a
135                 * logger facade caching its own resolved level and re-checking it on every call)
136                 * and a level would otherwise have to be made up just to obtain a working sink.
137                 * @param loggerName topic.
138                 * @return event logger, never <code>null</code>.
139                 */
140                public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName);
141
142                /**
143                 * Level resolver to find levels for a log name.
144                 * @return level resolver.
145                 */
146                public LevelResolver levelResolver();
147
148                /**
149                 * Register for a router changes usually involving the level resolver being
150                 * updated by config.
151                 * @param router consumer that will be called with the updated router.
152                 * @apiNote its best to use the router in the consumer accept argument and not
153                 * this router even if they are usually the same.
154                 */
155                public void onChange(Consumer<? super RootRouter> router);
156
157                /**
158                 * If a logger name configuration is changeable.
159                 * @param loggerName logger name.
160                 * @return true if config changes are allowed.
161                 */
162                public boolean isChangeable(String loggerName);
163
164        }
165
166        /**
167         * Router routes messages to a publisher.
168         */
169        sealed interface Router extends LogRouter, LogEventLogger {
170
171                /**
172                 * The router name given if no router is explicitly declared.
173                 */
174                public static final String DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME = LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME;
175
176                /**
177                 * Level resolver.
178                 * @return level resolver.
179                 */
180                LevelResolver levelResolver();
181
182                /**
183                 * Log publisher.
184                 * @return publisher.
185                 */
186                LogPublisher publisher();
187
188                /**
189                 * Whether or not the publisher is synchronous. A synchronous publisher generally
190                 * blocks.
191                 * @return true if the publisher is synchronous.
192                 */
193                default boolean synchronous() {
194                        return publisher().synchronous();
195                }
196
197                @Override
198                default void log(LogEvent event) {
199                        /*
200                         * Only async publishers need a frozen (immutable, defensively copied) event.
201                         * A synchronous publisher fully encodes and writes the event on the calling
202                         * thread before this call returns, so there is no other thread that could
203                         * observe or race with further mutation (e.g. MDC.put/remove) of the live
204                         * event data - freezing there would just be wasted allocation on the hot
205                         * path. Freeze is a noop if the event is already frozen.
206                         */
207                        if (!synchronous()) {
208                                event = event.freeze();
209                        }
210                        publisher().log(event);
211                }
212
213                /**
214                 * Creates a builder from config.
215                 * @param name name of the route which the publisher will inherit.
216                 * @param config config.
217                 * @return builder.
218                 */
219                static Builder builder(String name, LogConfig config) {
220                        /*
221                         * Eagerly triggers LogProperties' own key-parameter-value validation now:
222                         * needed because a fully-explicit route (explicit appenders, level,
223                         * publisher) never triggers a single keyed property lookup on its own, so
224                         * without this a malformed name would otherwise never be validated. Wrapped
225                         * into a ValidationException the same way a generated builder's constructor
226                         * is, so a bad name reports the same exception type regardless of whether it
227                         * came from logging.routes (RainbowGum.Builder's own validateNames call) or a
228                         * direct programmatic builder(name, config) call like this one.
229                         */
230                        try {
231                                LogProperties.interpolateNamedKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_LEVEL_PREFIX, name);
232                        }
233                        catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
234                                throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(LogRouter.class, e);
235                        }
236                        return new Builder(name, config);
237                }
238
239                /**
240                 * Creates a router.
241                 *
242                 * @see AbstractRouter
243                 */
244                @FunctionalInterface
245                public interface RouterFactory {
246
247                        /**
248                         * Builder will call this factory if passed in.
249                         * @param publisher publisher from builder.
250                         * @param levelResolver level resolver from builder.
251                         * @param name name from builder.
252                         * @param config config from builder.
253                         * @return router.
254                         */
255                        public Router create(LogPublisher publisher, LevelResolver levelResolver, String name, LogConfig config);
256
257                        /**
258                         * Creates a router from a function.
259                         * @param function <strong>the function may return <code>null</code></strong>
260                         * which indicates to ignore.
261                         * @return factory.
262                         */
263                        static RouterFactory of(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Function<LogEvent, @Nullable LogEvent> function) {
264                                return (pub, lr, n, c) -> new AbstractRouter(n, pub, lr) {
265                                        @Override
266                                        protected @Nullable LogEvent transformOrNull(LogEvent event) {
267                                                return function.apply(event);
268                                        }
269                                };
270                        }
271
272                }
273
274                /**
275                 * Router builder.
276                 */
277                public final class Builder extends LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder<Builder> implements LogConfig.ConfigSupport {
278
279                        private final LogConfig config;
280
281                        private final String name;
282
283                        private final EnumSet<RouteFlag> flags = EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
284
285                        private RouterFactory factory = (publisher, levelResolver, n, c) -> new SimpleRouter(n, publisher,
286                                        levelResolver);
287
288                        private List<LogProvider<LogAppender>> appenders = new ArrayList<>();
289
290                        private Builder(String name, LogConfig config) {
291                                this.name = Objects.requireNonNull(name);
292                                this.config = config;
293                        }
294
295                        private @Nullable PublisherFactory publisher;
296
297                        @Override
298                        protected Builder self() {
299                                return this;
300                        }
301
302                        /**
303                         * Gets the currently bound config.
304                         * @return config.
305                         */
306                        @Override
307                        public LogConfig config() {
308                                return this.config;
309                        }
310
311                        /**
312                         * Adds a flag.
313                         * @param flag flag added if not already added.
314                         * @return this.
315                         */
316                        public Builder flag(RouteFlag flag) {
317                                flags.add(flag);
318                                return this;
319                        }
320
321                        /**
322                         * Adds an appender by giving an appender builder to a consumer.
323                         * @param name appender name.
324                         * @param consumer consumer.
325                         * @return this builder.
326                         */
327                        public Builder appender(String name, Consumer<LogAppender.Builder> consumer) {
328                                var builder = LogAppender.builder(name);
329                                consumer.accept(builder);
330                                this.appenders.add(builder.build());
331                                return this;
332                        }
333
334                        /**
335                         * Adds an appender.
336                         * @param appender appender provider.
337                         * @return this builder.
338                         */
339                        public Builder appender(LogProvider<LogAppender> appender) {
340                                this.appenders.add(Objects.requireNonNull(appender));
341                                return self();
342                        }
343
344                        /**
345                         * Sets the publisher. Only one publisher to router.
346                         * @param publisher publisher.
347                         * @return this builder.
348                         */
349                        public Builder publisher(PublisherFactory publisher) {
350                                this.publisher = publisher;
351                                return self();
352                        }
353
354                        /**
355                         * Factory to use for creating the router.
356                         * @param factory router factory.
357                         * @return this.
358                         */
359                        public Builder factory(RouterFactory factory) {
360                                this.factory = Objects.requireNonNull(factory);
361                                return this;
362                        }
363
364                        Router build() {
365                                return build(this.factory);
366                        }
367
368                        /**
369                         * Builds the router.
370                         * @param factory to create the router.
371                         * @return router.
372                         */
373                        Router build(RouterFactory factory) {
374                                String name = this.name;
375                                flags.addAll(rawValue(config.properties()
376                                        .forKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_FLAGS_PROPERTY, name)
377                                        .ofList()
378                                        .map(RouteFlag::parse)
379                                        .or(EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class))).value());
380                                String routerLevelPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateNamedKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_LEVEL_PREFIX, name);
381
382                                /*
383                                 * The route's own level config is resolved in isolation from the global
384                                 * level resolver so that a route level override takes priority per logger
385                                 * name instead of merging with global by prefix specificity (a more
386                                 * specific global override would otherwise win over a coarser route
387                                 * override even though the route is meant to take precedence). If the
388                                 * route has no opinion at all for a given name (resolves to Level.ALL)
389                                 * resolution falls through to the global resolver for that name, unless
390                                 * IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER is set in which case global is never
391                                 * consulted.
392                                 */
393                                var routeLevelResolverBuilder = LevelResolver.builder();
394                                var currentConfig = buildLevelConfigOrNull();
395                                if (currentConfig != null) {
396                                        routeLevelResolverBuilder.config(currentConfig);
397                                }
398                                routeLevelResolverBuilder.config(config.properties(), routerLevelPrefix);
399                                /*
400                                 * config.levelResolver() (the global resolver) has no caching of its own
401                                 * - the previous single merged CompositeLevelConfig relied on being
402                                 * wrapped in one outer cache for the whole route+global composition.
403                                 * LevelResolver.Builder.build() restores that guarantee (level resolvers
404                                 * are cached / static, see LevelResolver's class documentation) for the
405                                 * combined route+global resolver below.
406                                 */
407                                if (!flags.contains(RouteFlag.IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER)) {
408                                        routeLevelResolverBuilder.fallback(config.levelResolver());
409                                }
410                                var levelResolver = routeLevelResolverBuilder.build().provide(name, config);
411
412                                if (currentConfig == null) {
413                                        /*
414                                         * If no config is provided in this route the global level might not
415                                         * be set.
416                                         */
417                                        var level = levelResolver.resolveLevel("");
418                                        Objects.requireNonNull(level);
419                                        if (level == System.Logger.Level.ALL) {
420                                                /*
421                                                 * Neither the route nor the global level resolver have anything
422                                                 * configured. This is a bug if this happens as the builders and
423                                                 * other places will turn ALL -> TRACE.
424                                                 */
425                                                levelResolver = LevelResolver.builder()
426                                                        .resolver(levelResolver)
427                                                        .fallback(StaticLevelResolver.INFO)
428                                                        .build()
429                                                        .provide(name, config);
430                                        }
431                                }
432
433                                var _levelResolver = levelResolver;
434                                /*
435                                 * This routers level resolver needs to be notified if config changes.
436                                 */
437                                config.changePublisher().subscribe(c -> {
438                                        _levelResolver.clear();
439                                });
440                                var publisher = this.publisher;
441
442                                List<LogProvider<LogAppender>> appenders = new ArrayList<>(this.appenders);
443                                if (appenders.isEmpty()) {
444                                        DefaultAppenderRegistry.appenders(config, name) //
445                                                .stream() //
446                                                .forEach(appenders::add);
447                                }
448
449                                if (publisher == null) {
450                                        var properties = config.properties();
451                                        publisher = rawValue(properties.forKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_PUBLISHER_PROPERTY, name)
452                                                .ofProviderRef()
453                                                .map(r -> config.publisherRegistry().provide(r))
454                                                .or(() -> LogPublisher.SyncLogPublisher.builder().build())).value();
455                                }
456
457                                var apps = new LogAppender.Appenders(name, config, appenders);
458                                var pub = publisher.create(name, config, apps);
459                                /*
460                                 * Register the publisher for lookup like status checks.
461                                 */
462                                config.serviceRegistry().put(LogPublisher.class, name, pub);
463                                return factory.create(pub, levelResolver, name, config);
464                        }
465
466                        /*
467                         * Both flags and publisher above already have a fallback applied (Missing is
468                         * impossible), but a present-but-malformed value must still surface its raw,
469                         * unwrapped exception - not a "Validation failed for Builder:" wrapping,
470                         * which would also change the exception's public type away from
471                         * PropertyConvertException (see ConfigFailureTest's bogus-scheme publisher
472                         * case). LogProperty.Result no longer exposes value() itself (a bare Result
473                         * might still be Missing), so this just narrows to
474                         * LogProperty.ValidatedResult - true for every concrete Result - without
475                         * going through a Validator at all.
476                         */
477                        private static <T> LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> rawValue(LogProperty.Result<T> result) {
478                                return switch (result) {
479                                        case LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> vr -> vr;
480                                };
481                        }
482
483                }
484
485        }
486
487        /**
488         * A user supplied router usually for filtering or transforming purposes. The method
489         * required to implement is {@link #transformOrNull(LogEvent)}.
490         *
491         * @see RouterFactory
492         */
493        @SuppressWarnings("javadoc") // TODO Eclipse bug.
494        public non-sealed abstract class AbstractRouter implements Router, Route {
495
496                private final String name;
497
498                private final LogPublisher publisher;
499
500                private final LevelResolver levelResolver;
501
502                /**
503                 * Router tuple of publisher and resolver.
504                 * @param name router name not <code>null</code>.
505                 * @param publisher not <code>null</code>.
506                 * @param levelResolver not <code>null</code>.
507                 */
508                protected AbstractRouter(String name, LogPublisher publisher, LevelResolver levelResolver) {
509                        super();
510                        this.name = name;
511                        this.publisher = publisher;
512                        this.levelResolver = levelResolver;
513                }
514
515                @Override
516                public final boolean synchronous() {
517                        return Router.super.synchronous();
518                }
519
520                @Override
521                public final void log(LogEvent event) {
522                        var e = transformOrNull(event);
523                        if (e != null) {
524                                Router.super.log(e);
525                        }
526                }
527
528                /**
529                 * Implement for custom filtering or transformation.
530                 * @param event usually from logging facade.
531                 * @return event to be pushed to logger or not if <code>null</code>.
532                 */
533                protected abstract @Nullable LogEvent transformOrNull(LogEvent event);
534
535                @Override
536                public final Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
537                        if (levelResolver().isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
538                                return this;
539                        }
540                        return Route.Routes.NotFound;
541                }
542
543                @Override
544                public final void start(LogConfig config) {
545                        publisher.start(config);
546                }
547
548                @Override
549                public final void close() {
550                        publisher.close();
551
552                }
553
554                @Override
555                public final boolean isEnabled() {
556                        return true;
557                }
558
559                @Override
560                public final LevelResolver levelResolver() {
561                        return this.levelResolver;
562                }
563
564                @Override
565                public final LogPublisher publisher() {
566                        return this.publisher;
567                }
568
569                @Override
570                public String toString() {
571                        return getClass() + "[name=" + name + ", publisher=" + publisher + ", levelResolver=" + levelResolver + "]";
572                }
573
574        }
575
576}

578record SimpleRouter(String name, LogPublisher publisher, LevelResolver levelResolver) implements Router, Route {
579

581        public void close() {
582                publisher.close();
583        }
584
585        @Override
586        public Route route(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {

602
603}
604
605sealed interface InternalRootRouter extends RootRouter {
606
607        /**
608         * Sets the root router.
609         * @param router root router.
610         */
611        static void setRouter(RootRouter router) {
612                if (GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE == router) {
613                        return;
614                }
615                GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE.drain((InternalRootRouter) router);
616        }
617
618        static InternalRootRouter of(List<? extends Router> routes, LogConfig config) {
619
620                if (routes.isEmpty()) {
621                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("atleast one route is required");
622                }
623                List<Router> sorted = new ArrayList<>();
624                /*
625                 * We add the async routers first
626                 */
627                Set<Router> matched = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Router, Boolean>());
628                for (var r : routes) {
629                        if (!r.synchronous()) {
630                                if (matched.add(r)) {
631                                        sorted.add(r);
632                                }
633                        }
634                }
635                for (var r : routes) {
636                        if (r.synchronous()) {
637                                if (matched.add(r)) {
638                                        sorted.add(r);
639                                }
640                        }
641                }
642                routes = sorted;
643                LevelResolver.Builder resolverBuilder = LevelResolver.builder();
644                routes.stream().map(Router::levelResolver).forEach(resolverBuilder::resolver);
645                var globalLevelResolver = resolverBuilder.build().provide("", config);
646
647                Router[] array = routes.toArray(new Router[] {});
648
649                RouteChangePublisher changePublisher = new RouteChangePublisher(
650                                s -> config.changePublisher().allowedChanges(s).contains(ChangeType.LEVEL));
651                if (array.length == 1) {
652                        var r = array[0];
653                        return new SingleRootRouter(r, changePublisher);
654                }
655                return new CompositeLogRouter(array, globalLevelResolver, changePublisher);
656        }
657
658        default boolean isEnabled(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
659                return route(loggerName, level).isEnabled();
660
661        }
662
663        default void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
664
665        }
666
667        @Override
668        default void onChange(Consumer<? super RootRouter> router) {
669                changePublisher().add(router);
670        }
671
672        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher();
673
674        @Override
675        default boolean isChangeable(String loggerName) {
676                return changePublisher().loggerChangeable.apply(loggerName);
677        }
678
679        final class RouteChangePublisher {
680
681                private final Collection<Consumer<? super RootRouter>> consumers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<Consumer<? super RootRouter>>();
682
683                private final Function<String, Boolean> loggerChangeable;
684
685                RouteChangePublisher(Function<String, Boolean> loggerChangeable) {
686                        super();
687                        this.loggerChangeable = loggerChangeable;
688                }
689
690                void add(Consumer<? super RootRouter> consumer) {
691                        consumers.add(consumer);
692                }
693
694                void publish(RootRouter router) {
695                        for (var c : consumers) {
696                                c.accept(router);
697                        }
698                }
699
700                void transferTo(RouteChangePublisher changePublisher) {
701                        changePublisher.consumers.addAll(consumers);
702                        this.consumers.clear();
703                }
704
705        }
706
707}
708

738@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent") // TODO revisit perf
739record CompositeLogRouter(Router[] routers, LevelResolver levelResolver,
740                RouteChangePublisher changePublisher) implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
741
742        @Override
743        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
744                /*
745                 * The assumption is the provided level resolver is a cached composite level
746                 * resolver of all the routers.
747                 */
748                if (levelResolver.isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
749                        return this;
750                }
751                return Routes.NotFound;
752        }
753
754        @Override
755        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
756                /*
757                 * log(LogEvent) below already fans out to every child router regardless of how it
758                 * was reached, so this composite is already its own sink - no per-child selection
759                 * happens until log() actually runs.
760                 */
761                return this;
762        }
763
764        @Override
765        public void log(LogEvent event) {
766                for (var router : routers) {
767                        var route = router.route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
768                        if (route.isEnabled()) {
769                                /*
770                                 * We assume async routers are earlier in the array.
771                                 */
772                                if (!router.synchronous()) {
773                                        /*
774                                         * Now all events are frozen from here onward to guarantee that the
775                                         * synchronous routers see the same thing as the async routers.
776                                         *
777                                         * Freeze is a noop if it already frozen.
778                                         */
779                                        event = event.freeze();
780                                }
781                                route.log(event);
782                        }
783                }
784        }
785
786        @Override
787        public boolean isEnabled() {
788                return true;
789        }
790
791        @Override
792        public void start(LogConfig config) {
793                for (var r : routers) {
794                        r.start(config);
795                }
796        }
797
798        @Override
799        public void close() {
800                for (var r : routers) {
801                        r.close();
802                }
803        }
804}

806final class QueueEventsRouter implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
807
808        private final ConcurrentLinkedQueue<LogEvent> events = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
809
810        private final LevelResolver levelResolver;
811
812        private final LevelResolver errorLevelResolver;
813
814        private final RouteChangePublisher changePublisher = new RouteChangePublisher(s -> true);
815
816        static QueueEventsRouter of() {
817                var validator = LogProperty.Validator.of(QueueEventsRouter.class);
818                var queueLevel = queueLevel().validate(validator);
819                var errorLevel = errorLevel().validate(validator);
820                validator.validate();
821                return new QueueEventsRouter(StaticLevelResolver.of(queueLevel.value()),
822                                StaticLevelResolver.of(errorLevel.value()));
823        }
824
825        private static LogProperty.Result<Level> queueLevel() {
826                var properties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
827                return properties.forKey(LogProperties.GLOBAL_QUEUE_LEVEL_PROPERTY)
828                        .ofString()
829                        .map(LevelResolver::parseLevel)
830                        .or(Level.INFO);
831        }
832
833        private static final LogProperty.Result<Level> errorLevel() {
834                var properties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
835                return properties.forKey(LogProperties.GLOBAL_QUEUE_ERROR_PROPERTY)
836                        .ofString()
837                        .map(LevelResolver::parseLevel)
838                        .or(Level.ERROR);
839        }
840
841        private QueueEventsRouter(LevelResolver levelResolver, LevelResolver errorLevelResolver) {
842                super();
843                this.levelResolver = levelResolver;
844                this.errorLevelResolver = errorLevelResolver;
845        }
846
847        @Override
848        public LevelResolver levelResolver() {
849                return levelResolver;
850        }
851
852        @Override
853        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
854                if (levelResolver.isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
855                        return this;
856                }
857                return Routes.NotFound;
858        }
859
860        @Override
861        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
862                return this;
863        }
864
865        @Override
866        public void start(LogConfig config) {
867        }
868
869        @Override
870        public void close() {
871                events.clear();
872        }
873
874        @Override
875        public void log(LogEvent event) {
876                events.add(event);
877                if (errorLevelResolver.isEnabled(event.loggerName(), event.level())) {
878                        MetaLog.error(event);
879                }
880        }
881
882        @Override
883        public void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
884                LogEvent e;
885                while ((e = this.events.poll()) != null) {
886                        delegate.route(e.loggerName(), e.level()).log(e);
887                }
888        }
889
890        @Override
891        public boolean isEnabled() {
892                return true;
893        }
894
895        @Override
896        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher() {
897                return this.changePublisher;
898        }
899
900}
901
902@SuppressWarnings("ImmutableEnumChecker")
903enum GlobalLogRouter implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
904
905        INSTANCE;
906
907        private volatile InternalRootRouter delegate = QueueEventsRouter.of();
908
909        private final ReentrantLock drainLock = new ReentrantLock();
910
911        @Override
912        public LevelResolver levelResolver() {
913                return delegate.levelResolver();
914        }
915
916        @Override
917        public boolean isEnabled() {
918                return true;
919        }
920
921        @Override
922        public void log(LogEvent event) {
923                InternalRootRouter d = delegate;
924                if (d instanceof QueueEventsRouter q) {
925                        q.log(event);
926                }
927                else {
928                        var route = d.route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
929                        if (route.isEnabled()) {
930                                route.log(event);
931                        }
932                }
933        }
934
935        @Override
936        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
937                return this.delegate.route(loggerName, level);
938        }
939
940        @Override
941        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
942                return this.delegate.eventLogger(loggerName);
943        }
944
945        @Override
946        public boolean isEnabled(String loggerName, Level level) {
947                return this.delegate.isEnabled(loggerName, level);
948        }
949
950        @Override
951        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher() {
952                return this.delegate.changePublisher();
953        }
954
955        @Override
956        public void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
957                _drain(delegate);
958        }
959
960        private InternalRootRouter _drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
961                if (delegate == this) {
962                        throw new IllegalStateException("bug");
963                }
964                drainLock.lock();
965                try {
966                        var original = this.delegate;
967                        if (original instanceof QueueEventsRouter q) {
968                                q.changePublisher().transferTo(delegate.changePublisher());
969                                delegate.changePublisher().publish(delegate);
970                        }
971                        this.delegate = Objects.requireNonNull(delegate);
972                        original.drain(delegate);
973                        return original;
974                }
975                finally {
976                        drainLock.unlock();
977                }
978        }
979
980        @Override
981        public void start(LogConfig config) {
982        }
983
984        @Override
985        public void close() {
986                var d = _drain(QueueEventsRouter.of());
987                d.close();
988        }
989
990}
